Thus the no-boundary proposal can explain why the universe is still so close to the critical rate of expansion.
To see what it predicts for the homogeneity and isotropy of the universe, one has to consider three-metrics hij which are perturbations of the round three-sphere metric.
One can expand these in terms of spherical harmonics.
There are three kinds: scalar harmonics, vector harmonics, and tensor harmonics.
The vector harmonics just correspond to changes of the coordinates Xi on successive three-spheres and play no dynamical role.
